units.source_text: 母女两人沉默了好一阵子。

en.t: Mother and daughter remained silent for quite a while.

units.source_text: 最后还是千重子忍耐不住，开口说了：

en.t: At last, Chieko could no longer hold back and spoke:

units.source_text: “我到锦市场去看看有什么菜，好准备晚饭。”

en.t: "I will go to Nishiki Market to see what ingredients there are, so I can prepare dinner."
